basics.name: Taleef Tamsal
basics.label: Software Engineer | Backend and AI Systems
basics.summary: Software engineer who ships production systems and measures whether they work. Rebuilt a healthcare compliance platform as sole developer, published three first-author works on model evaluation, and ran product operations at a startup.

work.name: Medical Informatics Engineering
work.summary: Rebuilt a production healthcare compliance platform's backend from Java 21/Spring Boot to modular TypeScript as sole developer, with zero breaking changes for API clients.
highlights: Implemented HL7 FHIR R4 EHR interoperability and regulatory exports for eight CMS quality measures, validated against 410 official MADiE test cases, and reported a confirmed reference-engine defect.
Designed a resumable batch pipeline over 70,000 PostgreSQL records with bounded memory and per-record failure isolation.
Shipped guardrailed AI assistants and read-only MCP tools, backed by 785 automated tests in CI and 43 architecture decision records.

work.name: Purdue University Fort Wayne
work.summary: Evaluated how adaptation methods and measurement choices affect jailbreak robustness for open-weight language models.
highlights: Automated SLURM pipelines fine-tuning 25 model configurations across five families with LoRA, QLoRA, full fine-tuning, and 4-bit quantization on A100 and A30 GPUs.
Ran an evaluation suite of nearly 600 measurements, exposing a 45.7% false-positive rate in a widely used automated evaluator versus 8.6% for a calibrated alternative.
Published three first-author works, including two SemEval-2026 system papers in the ACL Anthology.

work.name: Riccle
work.summary: Analyzed customer, transaction, and competitor data to shape positioning and channel strategy.
highlights: Automated go-to-market workflows that cut six hours per week of manual reconciliation.

work.name: Medical Informatics Engineering
work.summary: Built a containerized RAG platform for citation-backed search over enterprise documents.
highlights: Architected hybrid search and reranking with Node.js, Docker, OpenSearch, Redis, and PostgreSQL over 3,000+ documents at 85%+ context relevance.
Exposed REST, MCP, and SSE interfaces with structured citations, JWT/API-key authentication, user-scoped security filters, and OpenTelemetry observability.
